chunks: We place it in the hearts of the sinners.

key_terms.نَسْلُكُهُ: We place it / We make it enter

ai.seo_question: How does God place disbelief in the hearts of sinners according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse illustrates the concept of *Taqwin* (divine confirmation) rather than *Takwin* (creation), where God seals the hearts of those who have already chosen disbelief, as seen with Pharaoh. This divine action serves as a just consequence of their persistent rejection, reinforcing the principle that God does not force faith upon those who actively resist it.
